detail: Both authored React Native Android triggers stopped on the application UI in their first executed runs, and both causes are answered here. joplin: find_node walked up for an ancestor with clickable="true", and a React Native touchable frequently exposes no clickable attribute at all, so the walk ran off the top of the tree onto the root, which carries no bounds, and the long press failed with 'UI node has no usable bounds'. Resolution now prefers a clickable ancestor exactly as before, and falls back to the matching node itself, rising only as far as the nearest ancestor that has bounds a pointer action can target. Three unit cases guard it: a clickable ancestor is still preferred, a touchable without clickable is still addressable, and a subtree with no bounds anywhere is still reported rather than silently mistargeted. music: the previous record said the ARTISTS tab does not exist at cdd2305a. That was wrong about the mechanism and is corrected here. The navigation bar is a horizontal FlatList over index plus every displayed tab, and the default order is folder, playlist, track, album, artist, so ALBUMS and ARTISTS do exist but start off the right edge of a 1080 wide screen and never appear in a UiAutomator2 dump, which only reports visible nodes. Waiting for ARTISTS without scrolling could only ever time out. The trigger now waits for the home screen, then scrolls the bar within its own measured band until the tab is addressable, with a retained failure dump if eight swipes do not reveal it. The second cause of the same failure was real: the track count still read 0, because seed_music announced each file with ACTION_MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE, a protected broadcast MediaProvider stopped honouring long before API 36, so nothing was indexed. Seeding now calls MediaStore's scan_file per fixture and scan_volume for external_primary through the content provider, then queries the audio volume back and refuses to continue unless every fixture is present, and the campaign waits for the app's own track count to leave zero before navigating. The indexed rows are retained in each run record. react_native_android_campaign.py reached this repository's 1000 line ceiling with these changes, so the accessibility-tree addressing and gestures both applications share are split into react_native_android_ui.py. This is tooling work on the validation harness: no CLI behaviour changes and no promotion is claimed by this commit.
